units.sourceHTML: 5.1 Overview of regular expression in sed

units.text: To know how to use ⟦0⟧, people should understand regular expressions (⟦1⟧regexp⟦2⟧ for short). A regular expression is a pattern that is matched against a subject string from left to right. Most characters are ⟦3⟧ordinary⟦4⟧: they stand for themselves in a pattern, and match the corresponding characters. Regular expressions in ⟦5⟧ are specified between two slashes.
units.sourceHTML: To know how to use sed, people should understand regular expressions (regexp for short). A regular expression is a pattern that is matched against a subject string from left to right. Most characters are ordinary: they stand for themselves in a pattern, and match the corresponding characters. Regular expressions in sed are specified between two slashes.

units.text: The power of regular expressions comes from the ability to include alternatives and repetitions in the pattern. These are encoded in the pattern by the use of ⟦0⟧special characters⟦1⟧, which do not stand for themselves but instead are interpreted in some special way.
units.sourceHTML: The power of regular expressions comes from the ability to include alternatives and repetitions in the pattern. These are encoded in the pattern by the use of special characters, which do not stand for themselves but instead are interpreted in some special way.

units.text: The character ⟦0⟧ (caret) in a regular expression matches the beginning of the line. The character ⟦1⟧ (dot) matches any single character.
